description: This file defines the interface 'GlobalPropertyListener' which allows implementing classes to respond to create, update, or delete events of global properties within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: GlobalPropertyListener
classes.description: An interface that declares callback methods to be invoked when global properties are created, updated, or deleted in the system.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Determines if the listener wants to be notified about changes to a specific property identified by its name.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked after a global property is created or updated, providing the new value.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Callback invoked after a global property is deleted, providing the name of the deleted property.
